smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Floorplanner
shortDescription: Draws 2D and 3D floor plans in the browser. Up to 5 projects are free.
longDescription: Floorplanner lets you draw a floor plan and export 2D and 3D images. Up to 5 projects stay free, with SD exports that include a watermark. Credit packs start at $8.15 for 5 credits, and credits raise the export resolution up to 8K. See their site for current monthly plan prices.
pricingNotes: Up to 5 projects are free. Credit packs start at $8.15 for 5 credits. See their site for current monthly plan prices.
freeTierNotes: Up to 5 free projects with watermarked SD exports.
bestFor: A floor plan you draw and then export as a 2D or 3D image
A free project while you try the layout
notIdealFor: A photo of a blueprint with no drawing step
Virtual staging of a listing photo
strength: Floorplanner draws a floor plan in the browser and exports 2D and 3D images, with up to 5 projects free.
weakness: Free exports are watermarked SD images, and higher resolution spends credits that start at $8.15 for 5.
